terms.definition: What a project declares its source should stay aligned with. Structured today; the .md is what Render will produce from it.
The machine-readable file a mechanism reads: .spec/glossary.json, and one file per feature under .spec/behavior/.
The part of the structured specification a mechanism can check against source code.
The code verified against the specification. Glossary and Contract verify the implementation, Behavior the tests.
What tree-sitter answers for a source file: every token kept, comments included.

not.reason: An abstract tree drops the comments, which are the only thing Glossary reads.
